items.name: Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index_inj
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N]
  {f : α → β} {s : α →₀ M} {h : β → M → N},
  Function.Injective f → (Finsupp.mapDomain f s).sum h = s.sum fun a b => h (f a) b
